sourceOnlyInferences.inference: xpcshell uses GeckoProgram dependent linkage, hence xul-real plus NSPR/mozglue. xul-real links static xul and gkrust. Cocoa app-shim objects belong to xul. A genuine current-source xpcshell test cannot simply bypass XUL or its required Cocoa objects.

The stock full build traverses the configured normal tiers and all default compile roots, which can include roots outside the xpcshell closure. The binaries target also compiles all native default roots and macOS tools; it is not a shell-only shortcut. Which roots are avoidable for the existing test and bundle must be derived from the actual restored graph.

The current smoke expects the configured app bundle, XUL/xpcshell, generated modules, stock harness inputs and auxiliary programs. Mac bundle assembly declares the browser executable and configured extra inputs in the tools tier. A successful shell compile closure alone therefore does not establish a runnable existing smoke or full-host qualification.

mach writes .mozconfig.json with FileAvoidWrite, then can reconfigure if config.status/config_status_deps.in is missing or a dependency is newer/missing. Backend regeneration can also occur for newer/missing dependencies or missing recorded outputs. Retained effective-config success does not tell whether later build-side checks fired.

The archive rule uses Cargo dep-info plus manifest/lock/dependency mtimes to decide whether to recurse to force-cargo-library-build; that force recipe then invokes Cargo. Cargo invocation and actual Rust recompilation are separate decisions. Neither invocation, skip nor cache miss is established for47/48 by the preserved archive hash alone.

Export has forced buildid/source-repo stubs, but generated files use FileAvoidWrite and buildid_header consumes MOZ_BUILD_DATE. Reusing the producer build date avoids an intentional date-content change. This does not prove every generated file is unchanged or every export action is skipped.
